coverage.summary: Proposed ordinance. It would apply citywide in the City of San Diego to residential rental property, which it defines by reference to SDMC § 98.0702: any dwelling or unit intended for human habitation, including any dwelling or unit in a mobilehome park. It states no unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits. The Division 7 exemptions in § 98.0703 apply only to Division 7 and are not incorporated.

result.notes: Removed other_conditions. It described which software is prohibited, which is conduct, not building, unit or owner coverage. The software carve-outs in § 98.1102(a)-(b) (reports from aggregated data more than 90 days old or from public information; affordable-housing program rent-setting) are exclusions from the definition of 'algorithmic device'. They are not building exemptions, so they are not listed in unverifiable_exemptions. Division 11 borrows only the definitions of § 98.0702. The § 98.0703 exemptions, such as certificate of occupancy within 15 years, owner-occupied duplexes and deed-restricted affordable housing, are limited to 'This Division' (Division 7) and do not carry over. requires_unknown_facts is set to false because the rule covers ordinary rental dwellings. The ordinance remains a draft with a blank number and passage date, so the status is pending.
